title: Prepositions: di, a, da, in, con, su, per, tra/fra

blocks.markdown: Common prepositions: **di** (of/from), **a** (to/at), **da** (from/since/at someone's place), **in** (in/into), **con** (with), **su** (on), **per** (for), **tra/fra** (between/among — interchangeable). Several combine with definite articles (*a + il → al*, *in + la → nella*), but the plain forms are the building blocks to learn first.

exercises.prompt: Il libro è ___ tavolo. (on the table)

answer: Sto studiando con il mio amico.
